+# =============================================================================
+# experiments/run.py — one dispatcher for every stage
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Paper: Camargo & Finger, "MelT: GEMM-Native NDFT ...", IEEE Access, 2026.
+# Maps a stage name to its runner and routes output to results/raw/<id>/ (per
+# platform) or results/raw/tasks/ (CUDA-only tasks). Called by reproduce*.sh
+# and the Makefile.
+#
+# Usage:  python -m experiments.run <stage> --platform h100
+#         python -m experiments.run --platform h100 --all
+#         python -m experiments.run whisper --tasks
+# License: MIT.
+# =============================================================================
+"""Stage dispatcher: name -> runner, with per-platform / tasks output routing."""
+import argparse
+import importlib
+import yaml
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+# stage -> (module, is_task)
+REGISTRY = {
+    "latency":     ("experiments.latency", False),
+    "energy":      ("experiments.energy", False),
+    "external":    ("experiments.external_baselines", False),
+    "msweep":      ("experiments.msweep", False),
+    "batch":       ("experiments.batch_scaling", False),
+    "mlx":         ("experiments.mlx_bench", False),
+    "v100_power":  ("experiments.v100_power_profile", False),
+    "whisper":     ("experiments.tasks.whisper", True),
+    "voxceleb":    ("experiments.tasks.voxceleb", True),
+    "equivalence": ("experiments.tasks.feature_equivalence", True),
+    "spira_train": ("experiments.tasks.spira_train", True),   # train checkpoints
+    "spira":       ("experiments.tasks.spira_eval", True),    # eval (Table VII)
+}
+
+
+def _platform_stages(platform_id):
+    cfg = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "configs" / "platforms" / f"{platform_id}.yaml").read_text())
+    return cfg.get("stages", [])
+
+
+def run_stage(stage, platform_id, tasks, force, seeds=None):
+    mod_name, is_task = REGISTRY[stage]
+    mod = importlib.import_module(mod_name)
+    print(f"[run] {stage}  ({'tasks' if is_task else platform_id})")
+    # seeds is consumed by the multi-seed task runners (spira_train/spira/voxceleb);
+    # every other runner absorbs it via **_ and ignores it.
+    mod.run(platform_id=platform_id, force=force, seeds=seeds)
+
+
+def _parse_seeds(s):
+    """Parse '43,44,45' -> [43,44,45]; None/empty -> None (single-seed)."""
+    if not s:
+        return None
+    return [int(x) for x in str(s).replace(" ", "").split(",") if x != ""]
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="MelT experiment dispatcher")
+    ap.add_argument("stage", nargs="?", help="single stage name")
+    ap.add_argument("--platform", default=None)
+    ap.add_argument("--tasks", action="store_true", help="route to results/raw/tasks/")
+    ap.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="run all stages in scope")
+    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--seeds", default=None,
+                    help="comma-separated seeds for multi-seed tasks (e.g. 43,44,45,46,49)")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    seeds = _parse_seeds(a.seeds)
+
+    if a.all and a.platform:
+        for st in _platform_stages(a.platform):
+            run_stage(st, a.platform, False, a.force)
+    elif a.all and a.tasks:
+        for st in (s for s, (_, t) in REGISTRY.items() if t):
+            run_stage(st, None, True, a.force, seeds=seeds)
+    elif a.stage:
+        run_stage(a.stage, a.platform, a.tasks, a.force, seeds=seeds)
+    else:
+        ap.error("give a <stage>, or --platform X --all, or --tasks --all")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# =============================================================================
+# tasks/feature_equivalence.py — feature-level TOST battery -> Table VI, Fig 5
+# Paper: Camargo & Finger, "MelT ...", IEEE Access 2026.  License: MIT.
+# CUDA-only, hardware-independent in value. Reports that raw log-Mel features are
+# NOT bit-equivalent (honest), with an anchor-derived margin from a 1% f_max
+# retune; cosine/CCC describe the close shape. Output: results/raw/tasks/.
+# =============================================================================
+"""Pre-registered feature equivalence: anchor margin, TOST, cosine, CCC, RMSE."""
+import numpy as np
+from melt import baselines, dsp, stats, io
+from melt.melt import melt as melt_fn   # the function (the package re-exports it; not the submodule)
+from .. import _common as C
+
+NAT2DB = 4.342944819
+
+
+def run(platform_id=None, force=False, **_):
+    cfg = C.load_config("equivalence"); out = io.out_dir(tasks=True)
+    csv = out / "feature_equivalence.csv"
+    if csv.exists() and not force:
+        print(f"  skip (exists): {csv}"); return
+    sp = cfg["spectral"]; n = cfg["equivalence"]["n_clips"]
+    shift = cfg["equivalence"]["negligible_shift_pct"] / 100.0
+
+    per_clip_rmse, per_clip_cos, per_clip_ccc, anchor_rmse = [], [], [], []
+    # iterate n DISTINCT corpus clips (one statistical replicate each)
+    for audio in C.corpus_clips(cfg, n=n, secs=160):
+        melt_feat = melt_fn(audio, backend="numpy", **sp)
+        window = dsp.hann(sp["frame_len"]); fb = dsp.mel_filterbank(
+            sp["n_mels"], sp["frame_len"], cfg["sr"], sp["f_min"], sp["f_max"])
+        X = dsp.extract_frames(audio, sp["frame_len"], sp["hop_len"])
+        stft_feat = baselines.stft_mel_numpy(X, window, fb)
+        per_clip_rmse.append(float(np.sqrt(((melt_feat - stft_feat) ** 2).mean())))
+        per_clip_cos.append(stats.cosine_rows(melt_feat, stft_feat))
+        per_clip_ccc.append(stats.lin_ccc(melt_feat, stft_feat))   # Lin's CCC
+        # anchor: STFT+Mel vs STFT+Mel with f_max retuned by `shift` (negligible)
+        fb2 = dsp.mel_filterbank(sp["n_mels"], sp["frame_len"], cfg["sr"],
+                                 sp["f_min"], sp["f_max"] * (1 - shift))
+        s2 = baselines.stft_mel_numpy(X, window, fb2)
+        anchor_rmse.append(float(np.sqrt(((stft_feat - s2) ** 2).mean())))
+
+    delta = float(np.max(anchor_rmse))                       # anchor-derived margin (nat)
+    # Two one-sided non-inferiority reads, exactly as described for Table VI:
+    #   RMSE non-inferiority : is mean RMSE below the negligible-retune margin delta?
+    #   cosine non-inferiority: is mean cosine above the 0.99 similarity floor?
+    rmse_ni = stats.noninferiority(per_clip_rmse, delta, side="upper")
+    cos_ni = stats.noninferiority(per_clip_cos, 0.99, side="lower")
+
+    # 90% bootstrap CI of the MEAN over the n clips (deterministic seed)
+    _rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
+    def _boot_ci(a, B=2000):
+        a = np.asarray(a, float); k = len(a)
+        means = a[_rng.integers(0, k, size=(B, k))].mean(axis=1)
+        lo, hi = np.percentile(means, [5, 95]); return float(lo), float(hi)
+    cos_lo, cos_hi = _boot_ci(per_clip_cos)
+    ccc_lo, ccc_hi = _boot_ci(per_clip_ccc)
+    rmse_lo, rmse_hi = _boot_ci(per_clip_rmse)
+
+    rows = [["mean_cosine", float(np.mean(per_clip_cos)), ""],
+            ["mean_cosine_lo", cos_lo, "90% bootstrap CI of mean"],
+            ["mean_cosine_hi", cos_hi, ""],
+            ["mean_ccc", float(np.mean(per_clip_ccc)), "Lin's concordance"],
+            ["mean_ccc_lo", ccc_lo, ""],
+            ["mean_ccc_hi", ccc_hi, ""],
+            ["mean_rmse_nat", float(np.mean(per_clip_rmse)), ""],
+            ["mean_rmse_db", float(np.mean(per_clip_rmse)) * NAT2DB, ""],
+            ["mean_rmse_db_lo", rmse_lo * NAT2DB, ""],
+            ["mean_rmse_db_hi", rmse_hi * NAT2DB, ""],
+            ["margin_delta_nat", delta, ""],
+            ["margin_delta_db", delta * NAT2DB, ""],
+            ["rmse_noninferior", int(rmse_ni["passed"]), f"p={rmse_ni['p']:.3g} (RMSE<delta)"],
+            ["cosine_noninferior", int(cos_ni["passed"]), f"p={cos_ni['p']:.3g} (cos>=0.99)"]]
+    io.write_csv(csv, ["metric", "value", "note"], rows)
+    # per-clip raw dump: lets the CIs be recomputed offline, no re-run/corpus needed
+    io.write_csv(out / "feature_equivalence_raw.csv",
+                 ["clip", "cosine", "ccc", "rmse_nat", "anchor_rmse_nat"],
+                 [[i, per_clip_cos[i], per_clip_ccc[i], per_clip_rmse[i], anchor_rmse[i]]
+                  for i in range(len(per_clip_cos))])
+    io.write_run_json(out, "feature_equivalence", platform_id,
+                      "configs/experiments/equivalence.yaml")
+    print(f"  wrote {csv}  (mean cosine {np.mean(per_clip_cos):.3f}, "
+          f"RMSE {np.mean(per_clip_rmse)*NAT2DB:.2f} dB, delta {delta*NAT2DB:.2f} dB; "
+          f"RMSE non-inf={rmse_ni['passed']}, cosine non-inf={cos_ni['passed']})")

+# =============================================================================
+# tasks/spira_eval.py — SPIRA paired evaluation -> Table VII, Fig 6
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Paper: Camargo & Finger, "MelT: GEMM-Native NDFT ...", IEEE Access, 2026.
+#
+# CUDA-only; SPIRA is public clinical data (CC BY-SA 4.0, see data/spira.md).
+# Builds the SAME 606-window test set for both front ends from the vendored model
+# modules (spira_mfcc_model.py / spira_mfcct_model.py), then reports a full
+# clinical comparison of MFCC vs MFCCT:
+#   * window- AND patient-level Accuracy, Precision, Sensitivity, Specificity,
+#     F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC
+#   * McNemar (with odds ratio), patient-clustered paired bootstrap CIs for
+#     Acc/F1/AUC, and DeLong's test on the ROC-AUC difference
+#   * the drop-in test (MFCC-trained model on MFCCT features, frozen)
+#
+# Multi-seed (Tier 2): pass seeds=[...] (CLI --seeds) to evaluate per-seed
+# checkpoints under checkpoints/seed_<s>/ and report mean +/- std across seeds
+# plus a Wilcoxon signed-rank paired test on the per-seed MFCCT-MFCC differences
+# — robustness evidence that the gain is not a single-training-run artefact.
+#
+# Inference precision MATCHES training (bfloat16 autocast on CUDA). Output:
+# results/raw/tasks/. Ported/cleaned from exp/exp-arxiv-04-spira/dump_and_mcnemar.py.
+# License: MIT.
+# =============================================================================
+"""SPIRA paired clinical evaluation (single- and multi-seed) -> Table VII."""
+import importlib
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from melt import stats, io
+from .. import _common as C
+
+
+# ----------------------------- point metrics --------------------------------
+def _f1(labels, preds):
+    tp = np.sum((preds == 1) & (labels == 1)); fp = np.sum((preds == 1) & (labels == 0))
+    fn = np.sum((preds == 0) & (labels == 1))
+    return float(2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)) if (2 * tp + fp + fn) else 0.0
+
+
+def _acc(labels, preds):
+    return float((labels == preds).mean())
+
+
+def _precision(labels, preds):
+    tp = np.sum((preds == 1) & (labels == 1)); fp = np.sum((preds == 1) & (labels == 0))
+    return float(tp / (tp + fp)) if (tp + fp) else 0.0
+
+
+def _auc(labels, probs):
+    """ROC-AUC (sklearn for field-exact value; None if single-class/unavailable)."""
+    try:
+        from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
+        return float(roc_auc_score(labels, probs))
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def _ap(labels, probs):
+    """PR-AUC / average precision (sklearn); None if unavailable."""
+    try:
+        from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score
+        return float(average_precision_score(labels, probs))
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def _patient_probs(probs, labels, pid):
+    """Aggregate window probabilities to one mean-probability per patient.
+    Returns (patient_prob, patient_label) over the unique patients."""
+    probs = np.asarray(probs, float); labels = np.asarray(labels, int); pid = np.asarray(pid)
+    uniq = np.unique(pid)
+    pp = np.array([probs[pid == p].mean() for p in uniq])
+    pl = np.array([int(round(labels[pid == p].mean())) for p in uniq], dtype=int)
+    return pp, pl
+
+
+def _infer(model, dataset, device):
+    """(probs, labels) in dataset order, under bf16 autocast on CUDA (match train)."""
+    import torch
+    model.eval()
+    amp = device.type == "cuda"
+    loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=128, shuffle=False)
+    probs, labels = [], []
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for X, y in loader:
+            with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, dtype=torch.bfloat16, enabled=amp):
+                logits = model(X.to(device)).squeeze(1)
+            probs += torch.sigmoid(logits.float()).cpu().numpy().tolist()
+            labels += y.numpy().tolist()
+    return np.array(probs), np.array(labels, dtype=int)
+
+
+# ----------------------------- eval plumbing --------------------------------
+def _engines():
+    """Import the vendored SPIRA engines and initialise the MFCCT matrices."""
+    m_mfcc = importlib.import_module("experiments.tasks.spira_mfcc_model")
+    m_mfcct = importlib.import_module("experiments.tasks.spira_mfcct_model")
+    m_mfcct.build_mfcct_matrices(m_mfcct.CFG)
+    return m_mfcc, m_mfcct
+
+
+def _infer_pair(mfcc_ck, mfcct_ck, test_csv, root, device, m_mfcc, m_mfcct):
+    """Load the MFCC and MFCCT checkpoints and return aligned per-window outputs:
+    (labels, prob_mfcc, prob_mfcct, pid, handles) where handles=(ds_a,net_a,ds_b,net_b)."""
+    import torch
+    ds_a = m_mfcc.SPIRADataset(test_csv, root, m_mfcc.CFG)
+    net_a = m_mfcc.CasanovaCNN(ds_a[0][0].shape, m_mfcc.CFG["dropout"]).to(device)
+    net_a.load_state_dict(torch.load(mfcc_ck, map_location=device))
+    prob_a, lab_a = _infer(net_a, ds_a, device); pid = ds_a.patient_ids
+
+    ds_b = m_mfcct.SPIRADataset(test_csv, root, m_mfcct.CFG)
+    net_b = m_mfcct.CasanovaCNN(ds_b[0][0].shape, m_mfcct.CFG["dropout"]).to(device)
+    net_b.load_state_dict(torch.load(mfcct_ck, map_location=device))
+    prob_b, lab_b = _infer(net_b, ds_b, device)
+
+    assert np.array_equal(lab_a, lab_b), "labels not aligned — windowing differs!"
+    return lab_a, prob_a, prob_b, pid, (ds_a, net_a, ds_b, net_b)
+
+
+def _scalar_metrics(labels, prob_a, prob_b, pid):
+    """Headline window- and patient-level metrics for both front ends + deltas.
+    Used per-seed in the multi-seed branch (a, b = MFCC, MFCCT)."""
+    pa, pb = (prob_a > 0.5).astype(int), (prob_b > 0.5).astype(int)
+    ppa, plab = _patient_probs(prob_a, labels, pid)
+    ppb, _ = _patient_probs(prob_b, labels, pid)
+    pat_a, pat_b = (ppa > 0.5).astype(int), (ppb > 0.5).astype(int)
+    m = {
+        "mfcc_f1": _f1(labels, pa), "mfcct_f1": _f1(labels, pb),
+        "mfcc_auc": _auc(labels, prob_a), "mfcct_auc": _auc(labels, prob_b),
+        "mfcc_f1_patient": _f1(plab, pat_a), "mfcct_f1_patient": _f1(plab, pat_b),
+        "mfcc_auc_patient": _auc(plab, ppa), "mfcct_auc_patient": _auc(plab, ppb),
+    }
+    m["d_f1"] = m["mfcct_f1"] - m["mfcc_f1"]
+    m["d_auc"] = (m["mfcct_auc"] - m["mfcc_auc"]) if None not in (m["mfcc_auc"], m["mfcct_auc"]) else None
+    m["d_f1_patient"] = m["mfcct_f1_patient"] - m["mfcc_f1_patient"]
+    return m
+
+
+# ----------------------------- runners --------------------------------------
+def run(platform_id=None, force=False, seeds=None, **_):
+    cfg = C.load_config("spira")
+    out = io.out_dir(tasks=True)
+    import torch
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    root = Path(cfg["dataset_root"]) / "spira"
+    test_csv = root / "metadata_test.csv"
+    ck = root / "checkpoints"
+    m_mfcc, m_mfcct = _engines()
+
+    if seeds:
+        _run_multiseed(seeds, force, cfg, out, ck, test_csv, root, device,
+                       m_mfcc, m_mfcct, platform_id)
+        return
+
+    csv = out / "spira_metrics.csv"
+    if csv.exists() and not force:
+        print(f"  skip (exists): {csv}"); return
+    mfcc_ck, mfcct_ck = ck / "spira_final_model.pth", ck / "spira_mfcct_final_model.pth"
+    assert test_csv.exists() and mfcc_ck.exists() and mfcct_ck.exists(), \
+        f"missing SPIRA data/checkpoints under {root} (see data/spira.md)"
+
+    labels, prob_a, prob_b, pid, (ds_a, net_a, ds_b, net_b) = _infer_pair(
+        mfcc_ck, mfcct_ck, test_csv, root, device, m_mfcc, m_mfcct)
+    pred_a, pred_b = (prob_a > 0.5).astype(int), (prob_b > 0.5).astype(int)
+    margin = cfg["spira"]["non_inferiority_margin"]; n_boot = cfg["spira"]["bootstrap"]
+
+    # provenance: paired per-window predictions
+    io.write_csv(out / "spira_per_window.csv",
+                 ["idx", "patient_id", "label", "mfcc_prob", "mfcc_pred",
+                  "mfcct_prob", "mfcct_pred"],
+                 [[i, int(pid[i]), int(labels[i]), f"{prob_a[i]:.6f}", int(pred_a[i]),
+                   f"{prob_b[i]:.6f}", int(pred_b[i])] for i in range(len(labels))])
+
+    # McNemar (+ odds ratio)
+    b = int(((pred_a == labels) & (pred_b != labels)).sum())   # MFCC-only right
+    c = int(((pred_b == labels) & (pred_a != labels)).sum())   # MFCCT-only right
+    mc = stats.mcnemar(b, c)
+
+    # patient-level aggregates
+    ppa, plab = _patient_probs(prob_a, labels, pid)
+    ppb, _ = _patient_probs(prob_b, labels, pid)
+    pat_a, pat_b = (ppa > 0.5).astype(int), (ppb > 0.5).astype(int)
+    n_pat = len(plab)
+
+    def clinical(tag, lab, pred, prob, note):
+        return [[f"{tag}_acc", _acc(lab, pred), note],
+                [f"{tag}_precision", _precision(lab, pred), ""],
+                [f"{tag}_sensitivity", stats.sensitivity(lab, pred), ""],
+                [f"{tag}_specificity", stats.specificity(lab, pred), ""],
+                [f"{tag}_f1", _f1(lab, pred), ""],
+                [f"{tag}_auc", _auc(lab, prob) if _auc(lab, prob) is not None else "", ""],
+                [f"{tag}_ap", _ap(lab, prob) if _ap(lab, prob) is not None else "", "PR-AUC"]]
+
+    rows = []
+    rows += clinical("mfcc", labels, pred_a, prob_a, "window-level (606 windows)")
+    rows += clinical("mfcct", labels, pred_b, prob_b, "window-level")
+    rows += clinical("mfcc_patient", plab, pat_a, ppa, f"patient-level (n={n_pat}, mean-prob>=0.5)")
+    rows += clinical("mfcct_patient", plab, pat_b, ppb, "patient-level")
+
+    # McNemar + odds ratio + DeLong on AUC
+    de = stats.delong_roc_test(labels, prob_a, prob_b)
+    rows += [["mcnemar_b", b, "window-level discordant"], ["mcnemar_c", c, ""],
+             ["mcnemar_p", mc["p"], f"chi2cc={mc['chi2_cc']:.2f}"],
+             ["mcnemar_p_exact", mc["p_exact"], ""],
+             ["mcnemar_odds_ratio", stats.mcnemar_odds_ratio(b, c), "MFCCT vs MFCC"],
+             ["delong_auc_p", de["p"], f"z={de['z']:.2f} (MFCCT vs MFCC AUC)"]]
+
+    # paired bootstrap (patient-clustered) for Acc/F1 (binary preds) and AUC (probs)
+    boots = {}
+    for mname, mfn in (("acc", _acc), ("f1", _f1)):
+        boots[(mname, "window")] = stats.metric_bootstrap(mfn, labels, pred_a, pred_b, n_boot=n_boot)
+        boots[(mname, "patient")] = stats.metric_bootstrap(mfn, labels, pred_a, pred_b, groups=pid, n_boot=n_boot)
+    boots[("auc", "window")] = stats.metric_bootstrap(stats.roc_auc, labels, prob_a, prob_b, n_boot=n_boot)
+    boots[("auc", "patient")] = stats.metric_bootstrap(stats.roc_auc, labels, prob_a, prob_b, groups=pid, n_boot=n_boot)
+    for (mname, level), r in boots.items():
+        rows += [[f"boot_d{mname}_{level}_mean", r["mean_diff"], ""],
+                 [f"boot_d{mname}_{level}_ci90_lo", r["ci90"][0], ""],
+                 [f"boot_d{mname}_{level}_ci90_hi", r["ci90"][1], ""]]
+    rows += [["noninferior_acc_patient", int(boots[("acc", "patient")]["ci90"][0] > -margin), f"margin={margin}"],
+             ["noninferior_f1_patient", int(boots[("f1", "patient")]["ci90"][0] > -margin), f"margin={margin}"]]
+
+    # drop-in (forward): MFCC-trained model on MFCCT features (center=True to match T)
+    cfg_center = dict(m_mfcct.CFG); cfg_center["center"] = True
+    ds_b_centered = m_mfcct.SPIRADataset(test_csv, root, cfg_center)
+    if ds_a[0][0].shape == ds_b_centered[0][0].shape:
+        prob_x, lab_x = _infer(net_a, ds_b_centered, device)
+        assert np.array_equal(lab_x, labels), "drop-in labels misaligned"
+        pred_x = (prob_x > 0.5).astype(int)
+        ppx, _ = _patient_probs(prob_x, labels, pid); pat_x = (ppx > 0.5).astype(int)
+        rows += [["mfcc_model_on_mfcct_f1", _f1(labels, pred_x), "drop-in (window)"],
+                 ["mfcc_model_on_mfcct_f1_patient", _f1(plab, pat_x), "drop-in (patient)"]]
+    else:
+        rows += [["mfcc_model_on_mfcct_f1", "shape_mismatch",
+                  f"{ds_a[0][0].shape} vs {ds_b_centered[0][0].shape}"]]
+
+    io.write_csv(csv, ["metric", "value", "note"], rows)
+    io.write_run_json(out, "spira", platform_id, "configs/experiments/spira.yaml")
+    print(f"  wrote {csv}  (window F1 MFCC {_f1(labels,pred_a):.4f} vs MFCCT {_f1(labels,pred_b):.4f}; "
+          f"AUC {_auc(labels,prob_a):.4f} vs {_auc(labels,prob_b):.4f}, DeLong p={de['p']:.3g}; "
+          f"McNemar b={b} c={c} p={mc['p']:.3f})")
+
+
+def _run_multiseed(seeds, force, cfg, out, ck, test_csv, root, device,
+                   m_mfcc, m_mfcct, platform_id):
+    """Evaluate per-seed checkpoints and report mean+/-std + Wilcoxon across seeds."""
+    seeds_csv = out / "spira_seeds.csv"
+    if seeds_csv.exists() and not force:
+        print(f"  skip (exists): {seeds_csv}"); return
+    per_seed = []
+    for s in seeds:
+        sdir = ck / f"seed_{s}"
+        mfcc_ck, mfcct_ck = sdir / "spira_final_model.pth", sdir / "spira_mfcct_final_model.pth"
+        assert mfcc_ck.exists() and mfcct_ck.exists(), \
+            f"missing seed-{s} checkpoints under {sdir} (train with --seeds first)"
+        labels, prob_a, prob_b, pid, _ = _infer_pair(
+            mfcc_ck, mfcct_ck, test_csv, root, device, m_mfcc, m_mfcct)
+        m = _scalar_metrics(labels, prob_a, prob_b, pid); m["seed"] = s
+        per_seed.append(m)
+        print(f"  seed {s}: F1 {m['mfcc_f1']:.4f}->{m['mfcct_f1']:.4f} "
+              f"(d={m['d_f1']:+.4f}), AUC d={m['d_auc']:+.4f}" if m['d_auc'] is not None else
+              f"  seed {s}: F1 {m['mfcc_f1']:.4f}->{m['mfcct_f1']:.4f}")
+
+    keys = ["seed", "mfcc_f1", "mfcct_f1", "d_f1", "mfcc_auc", "mfcct_auc", "d_auc",
+            "mfcc_f1_patient", "mfcct_f1_patient", "d_f1_patient", "mfcc_auc_patient",
+            "mfcct_auc_patient"]
+    io.write_csv(seeds_csv, keys,
+                 [[m.get(k, "") if m.get(k) is not None else "" for k in keys] for m in per_seed])
+
+    # aggregate: mean +/- std across seeds, and Wilcoxon on the per-seed deltas
+    def col(k):
+        return np.array([m[k] for m in per_seed if m.get(k) is not None], float)
+    summ = []
+    for base in ("f1", "auc", "f1_patient", "auc_patient"):
+        a, b = col(f"mfcc_{base}"), col(f"mfcct_{base}")
+        if a.size == 0 or b.size == 0 or a.size != b.size:
+            continue
+        d = b - a
+        w = stats.wilcoxon_signed_rank(d)
+        summ.append([base, f"{a.mean():.4f}", f"{a.std(ddof=1):.4f}",
+                     f"{b.mean():.4f}", f"{b.std(ddof=1):.4f}",
+                     f"{d.mean():+.4f}", f"{d.std(ddof=1):.4f}",
+                     f"{w['p']:.4g}", len(d)])

+class Mish(nn.Module):
+    """
+    Mish activation function: x * tanh(softplus(x)).

+        self.gn2   = nn.GroupNorm(8, 16)
+        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))
+        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout2d(dropout_prob)
+
+        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(16, 8, 3,

+        self.gn3   = nn.GroupNorm(4, 8)
+        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))
+        self.drop3 = nn.Dropout2d(dropout_prob)

+        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))

+        # ── Fully-connected head ──────────────────────────────────────────

+        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(64, 1)

+    def _forward_conv(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run only the convolutional blocks (used to infer flat_size)."""
+        x = self.drop1(self.pool1(self.act(self.gn1(self.conv1(x)))))
+        x = self.drop2(self.pool2(self.act(self.gn2(self.conv2(x)))))
+        x = self.drop3(self.pool3(self.act(self.gn3(self.conv3(x)))))
+        x = self.drop4(self.pool4(self.act(self.gn4(self.conv4(x)))))
+        return x
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """
+        Forward pass.
+        Input  : (B, 1, n_mfcc, T)
+        Output : (B, 1) — raw logit (apply torch.sigmoid() to get probability)
+        """
+        x = self._forward_conv(x)
+        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)          # flatten
+        x = self.act(self.fc1(x))
+        x = self.act(self.fc2(x))
+        return self.fc3(x)   # raw logit — apply sigmoid externally for probabilities

+# =============================================================================
+# LEARNING-RATE SCHEDULER
+# =============================================================================
+def noam_lr_lambda(step: int, warmup_steps: int = 1000) -> float:
+    """
+    Noam (transformer) learning-rate schedule.
+    Linearly warms up for `warmup_steps`, then decays as 1/sqrt(step).
+    Applied via LambdaLR so it works per-optimizer-step, not per-epoch.
+    """
+    step = max(step, 1)
+    return warmup_steps ** 0.5 * min(step ** -0.5,
+                                      step * warmup_steps ** -1.5)
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# TRAINING HELPERS
+# =============================================================================
+def train_one_epoch(model: nn.Module, loader: DataLoader,
+                    optimizer: optim.Optimizer, scheduler: LambdaLR,
+                    criterion: nn.Module, device: torch.device,
+                    use_amp: bool = False) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    """
+    Run one full training epoch.
+
+    When use_amp=True, wraps each forward pass in torch.autocast with
+    bfloat16 (H100 native precision). No GradScaler is needed because
+    bfloat16 has the same exponent range as float32.
+
+    Returns (mean_loss, accuracy) over the epoch.
+    """
+    model.train()
+    total_loss = correct = n = 0
+    amp_dtype  = torch.bfloat16 if use_amp else None
+
+    for X, y in loader:
+        X, y = X.to(device, non_blocking=True), y.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+        optimizer.zero_grad()
+
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type,
+                            dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
+            out  = model(X).squeeze(1)      # (B,)
+            loss = criterion(out, y)
+
+        loss.backward()
+        optimizer.step()

+
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            preds    = (out.float() > 0.0).float()   # logit > 0 ↔ prob > 0.5
+            correct += (preds == y).sum().item()
+        n          += y.size(0)
+        total_loss += loss.item() * y.size(0)
+
+    return total_loss / n, correct / n
+

+@torch.no_grad()
+def evaluate(model: nn.Module, loader: DataLoader,
+             criterion: nn.Module, device: torch.device,
+             use_amp: bool = False) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    """
+    Evaluate the model on `loader` without gradient computation.
+    Returns (mean_loss, accuracy).
+    """
+    model.eval()
+    total_loss = correct = n = 0
+    amp_dtype  = torch.bfloat16 if use_amp else None
+
+    for X, y in loader:
+        X, y = X.to(device, non_blocking=True), y.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type,
+                            dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
+            out  = model(X).squeeze(1)
+            loss = criterion(out, y)
+        preds       = (out.float() > 0.0).float()   # logit > 0 ↔ prob > 0.5
+        correct    += (preds == y).sum().item()
+        n          += y.size(0)
+        total_loss += loss.item() * y.size(0)
+
+    return total_loss / n, correct / n

+@torch.no_grad()
+def compute_metrics(model: nn.Module, loader: DataLoader,
+                    device: torch.device, threshold: float = 0.5,
+                    use_amp: bool = False) -> dict:
+    """
+    Compute full classification metrics on `loader`.

+    Returns a dict with keys:
+        accuracy, precision, recall, f1, auc, confusion_matrix
+    """
+    model.eval()
+    all_probs: list[float] = []
+    all_labels: list[int]  = []
+    amp_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if use_amp else None
+
+    for X, y in loader:
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type,
+                            dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
+            logits = model(X.to(device, non_blocking=True)).squeeze(1)
+        probs = torch.sigmoid(logits).float().cpu().numpy()
+        all_probs.extend(probs.tolist())
+        all_labels.extend(y.numpy().tolist())
+
+    probs  = np.array(all_probs)
+    labels = np.array(all_labels, dtype=int)
+    preds  = (probs > threshold).astype(int)
+
+    return dict(
+        accuracy  = float(accuracy_score(labels, preds)),
+        precision = float(precision_score(labels, preds, zero_division=0)),
+        recall    = float(recall_score(labels, preds, zero_division=0)),
+        f1        = float(f1_score(labels, preds, zero_division=0)),
+        auc       = float(roc_auc_score(labels, probs)),
+        confusion_matrix = confusion_matrix(labels, preds).tolist(),
+    )

+        log.info(f"{'─'*60}")
+
+        # Map patient splits → window indices
+        tr_patients = set(unique_pids[tr_pat])
+        vl_patients = set(unique_pids[vl_pat])
+        train_idx   = np.where(np.isin(all_pids, list(tr_patients)))[0]
+        val_idx     = np.where(np.isin(all_pids, list(vl_patients)))[0]
+
+        log.info(f"  Patients — train: {len(tr_patients)}  val: {len(vl_patients)}")
+        log.info(f"  Windows  — train: {len(train_idx)}  val: {len(val_idx)}")
+
+        # ── Build fold loaders ────────────────────────────────────────────
+        train_sub = Subset(full_dataset, train_idx)
+        val_sub   = Subset(full_dataset, val_idx)
+        nw = cfg["num_workers"]
+        pf = cfg["prefetch_factor"] if nw > 0 else None
+        train_ld  = DataLoader(train_sub, batch_size=cfg["batch_size"],
+                               shuffle=True,  num_workers=nw,
+                               pin_memory=cfg["pin_memory"],
+                               persistent_workers=(nw > 0),
+                               prefetch_factor=pf)
+        val_ld    = DataLoader(val_sub,   batch_size=cfg["batch_size"],
+                               shuffle=False, num_workers=nw,
+                               pin_memory=cfg["pin_memory"],
+                               persistent_workers=(nw > 0),
+                               prefetch_factor=pf)
+
+        # ── Build model + optimiser ───────────────────────────────────────
+        sample_shape = full_dataset[0][0].shape   # (1, n_mfcc, T)
+        model  = CasanovaCNN(sample_shape, cfg["dropout"]).to(device)
+        crit   = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()   # fused sigmoid+BCE — safe with autocast
+        opt    = optim.Adam(model.parameters(),
+                            lr=cfg["lr"], weight_decay=cfg["weight_decay"])
+        sched  = LambdaLR(opt, lr_lambda=lambda s: noam_lr_lambda(
+                              s, cfg["warmup_steps"]))
+        use_amp = cfg["use_amp"] and device.type == "cuda"
+
+        best_val_loss = float("inf")
+        best_state    = None
+        no_improve    = 0
+
+        for epoch in range(1, cfg["epochs"] + 1):
+            tr_loss, tr_acc = train_one_epoch(
+                model, train_ld, opt, sched, crit, device, use_amp)

+            improved = vl_loss < best_val_loss
+            if improved:

+                tag = ""

+                f"  Fold {fold} | Ep {epoch:4d}/{cfg['epochs']} | "
+                f"tr_loss={tr_loss:.4f} tr_acc={tr_acc:.4f} | "
+                f"vl_loss={vl_loss:.4f} vl_acc={vl_acc:.4f}{tag}"
+            )

+                log.info(f"  Early stopping at epoch {epoch} "
+                         f"(no improvement for {cfg['patience']} epochs)")

+
+        # ── Reload best weights and compute metrics ───────────────────────
+        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+        metrics = compute_metrics(model, val_ld, device, use_amp=use_amp)
+        metrics["fold"] = fold

+        ckpt_path = out_dir / f"spira_fold{fold}_best.pth"
+        torch.save(best_state, ckpt_path)
+        log.info(f"  Fold {fold} checkpoint → {ckpt_path.name}")
+        log.info(
+            f"  Fold {fold} BEST → "
+            f"acc={metrics['accuracy']:.4f}  "
+            f"prec={metrics['precision']:.4f}  "
+            f"rec={metrics['recall']:.4f}  "
+            f"f1={metrics['f1']:.4f}  "
+            f"auc={metrics['auc']:.4f}"
+        )

+def train_final_model(train_dataset: SPIRADataset, cfg: dict,
+                      device: torch.device, out_dir: Path,
+                      log: logging.Logger) -> nn.Module:
+    """
+    Train a single model on the entire training set (no validation split).
+    Uses the same architecture and hyperparameters as the CV folds.
+    Saves the best checkpoint (by training loss) to out_dir/spira_final_model.pth.
+
+    This is the model used for downstream QCVS inference.
+    """
+    log.info(f"\n{'═'*60}")
+    log.info("  FINAL MODEL — training on full training set")
+    log.info(f"{'═'*60}")
+
+    nw = cfg["num_workers"]
+    pf = cfg["prefetch_factor"] if nw > 0 else None
+    train_ld = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=cfg["batch_size"],
+                          shuffle=True, num_workers=nw,
+                          pin_memory=cfg["pin_memory"],
+                          persistent_workers=(nw > 0),
+                          prefetch_factor=pf)
+
+    sample_shape = train_dataset[0][0].shape
+    model   = CasanovaCNN(sample_shape, cfg["dropout"]).to(device)
+    crit    = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()   # fused sigmoid+BCE — safe with autocast
+    opt     = optim.Adam(model.parameters(),
+                         lr=cfg["lr"], weight_decay=cfg["weight_decay"])
+    sched   = LambdaLR(opt, lr_lambda=lambda s: noam_lr_lambda(
+                           s, cfg["warmup_steps"]))
+    use_amp = cfg["use_amp"] and device.type == "cuda"
+
+    best_loss  = float("inf")
+    best_state = None
+
+    for epoch in range(1, cfg["epochs"] + 1):
+        tr_loss, tr_acc = train_one_epoch(
+            model, train_ld, opt, sched, crit, device, use_amp)
+
+        improved = tr_loss < best_loss
+        if improved:
+            best_loss  = tr_loss
+            best_state = {k: v.cpu().clone()
+                          for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+
+        log.info(
+            f"  Final | Ep {epoch:4d}/{cfg['epochs']} | "
+            f"tr_loss={tr_loss:.4f} tr_acc={tr_acc:.4f}"
+            + (" ✓" if improved else "")
+        )
+
+    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+    ckpt_path = out_dir / "spira_final_model.pth"
+    torch.save(best_state, ckpt_path)
+    log.info(f"  Final model checkpoint → {ckpt_path.name}")
+    return model

+# =============================================================================
+# spira_mfcct_model.py — SPIRA dataset + CasanovaCNN (MFCCT frontend)
+# Vendored from exp/exp-arxiv-04-spira/train_mfcct.py for the MelT reproduction
+# package. Paper: Camargo & Finger, IEEE Access 2026.
+# The MFCCT feature math (Mel projection bases + DCT-II + log) is NOT redefined
+# here: it is sourced from the single canonical kernel in src/melt (dsp.py +
+# melt.py), so MelT/MFCCT come from one place throughout the repo. The original
+# in-file formulas were verified bit-identical to the canonical kernel before
+# this delegation (same [1:-1] Mel-center grid, symmetric Hann, orthonormal
+# DCT-II, log(S+1e-6)). License: MIT (see repo LICENSE).
+# =============================================================================
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+train_mfcct.py — CasanovaCNN biomarker training with MFCCT frontend
+====================================================================
+Drop-in companion to train.py.  Identical architecture, hyperparameters,
+and evaluation protocol.  The only difference: the MFCC frontend
+(librosa FFT → Mel filterbank → log → DCT) is replaced by MFCCT
+(MelTF matmul → log → DCT), i.e. three precomputed dense matmuls with
+no FFT.
+
+MFCCT pipeline:
+    fragment  →  extract_frames(FRAME_LEN, HOP_LEN)  →  X   [T, FRAME_LEN]
+    X @ W_r.T →  real part of Mel projection          [T, N_MELS]
+    X @ W_i.T →  imag part of Mel projection          [T, N_MELS]
+    S         =  (X @ W_r.T)² + (X @ W_i.T)²         [T, N_MELS]
+    log(S+ε) @ D.T                                    [T, N_MFCC]
+    transpose →                                       [N_MFCC, T]
+
+W_r, W_i are the MelTF weight matrices (real and imaginary Fourier basis
+functions windowed with Hann, evaluated at Mel-scale frequencies).
+D is the orthonormal DCT-II matrix (same scipy/librosa/Kaldi convention
+used in train.py's librosa.feature.mfcc).
+
+DSP parameters are chosen to match train.py exactly:
+    FRAME_LEN = n_fft  = 1200   (75 ms at 16 kHz)
+    HOP_LEN   = mfcc_hop = 160  (10 ms hop)
+    N_MELS    = 128              (librosa default for melspectrogram)
+    N_MFCC    = 40               (same as n_mfcc in train.py)
+    F_MIN     = 0.0              (librosa default)
+    F_MAX     = 8000.0           (librosa default = sr / 2)
+
+Frame extraction uses no center-padding (center=False semantics), which
+matches librosa.feature.mfcc(..., center=False).  To keep T identical
+between the two scripts, pass center=False if you ever compare outputs
+from train.py directly.
+
+Usage:
+    python train_mfcct.py \
+        --data-dir  /PATH/TO/spira \                 # SPIRA dataset root (see data/spira.md)
+        --train-csv /PATH/TO/spira/metadata_train.csv \
+        --test-csv  /PATH/TO/spira/metadata_test.csv \
+        --out-dir   outputs_mfcct
+
+Outputs (written to --out-dir):
+    spira_mfcct_final_model.pth
+    spira_mfcct_fold{k}_best.pth
+    spira_mfcct_cv_results.csv
+    spira_mfcct_test_results.csv
+    spira_mfcct_comparison_table.csv
+    training_mfcct.log

+
+# Baseline MFCC results (train.py) — filled in for easy comparison.
+BASELINE_RESULTS = dict(
+    accuracy  = 0.9719,
+    precision = 0.9663,
+    recall    = 0.9813,
+    f1        = 0.9737,
+    auc       = 0.9976,
+)
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# MFCCT WEIGHT MATRICES  (built once, reused across all dataset items)
+# =============================================================================
+
+# NOTE: the MelT/MFCCT feature math is sourced from the single canonical kernel
+# in src/melt (dsp.meltf_weights / dsp.dct_ii_matrix / dsp.extract_frames /
+# melt.direct_mel_projection). The thin wrappers below preserve this file's public
+# API (build_meltf_weights / build_dct_matrix / build_mfcct_matrices /
+# compute_mfcct) while delegating all the actual DSP to that one place.
+
+def build_meltf_weights(frame_len: int, n_mels: int,
+                        f_min: float, f_max: float,
+                        sr: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Real/imag MelT projection matrices — delegates to dsp.meltf_weights
+    (symmetric Hann, [1:-1] Mel-center grid). Shapes (n_mels, frame_len)."""
+    return _dsp.meltf_weights(n_mels, frame_len, sr, f_min, f_max)
+
+
+def build_dct_matrix(n_mfcc: int, n_mels: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Orthonormal DCT-II matrix [n_mfcc, n_mels] — delegates to dsp.dct_ii_matrix."""
+    return _dsp.dct_ii_matrix(n_mfcc, n_mels)
+
+
+# Module-level matrices — built in main() before dataset construction.
+_W_R: np.ndarray | None = None
+_W_I: np.ndarray | None = None
+_D:   np.ndarray | None = None
+
+
+def build_mfcct_matrices(cfg: dict) -> None:
+    """Initialise module-level MFCCT matrices from CFG (via the canonical kernel)."""
+    global _W_R, _W_I, _D
+    _W_R, _W_I = build_meltf_weights(
+        frame_len = cfg["frame_len"],
+        n_mels    = cfg["n_mels"],
+        f_min     = cfg["f_min"],
+        f_max     = cfg["f_max"],
+        sr        = cfg["sample_rate"],
+    )
+    _D = build_dct_matrix(cfg["n_mfcc"], cfg["n_mels"])
+
+
+def compute_mfcct(fragment: np.ndarray, center: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
+    """MFCCT for one audio window using the module-level matrices.
+
+    fragment -> frames X [T, frame_len] -> S = |proj|^2 -> log(S+EPS) @ D.T,
+    transposed to (n_mfcc, T). With center=False this matches
+    librosa.feature.mfcc(..., center=False); with center=True it reflect-pads the
+    signal by frame_len//2 (like librosa's default center=True) so the frame count
+    T matches a librosa MFCC computed with center=True — needed only for the
+    drop-in test (feeding MFCCT into an MFCC-trained, center=True model).
+    The framing and projection come from the canonical src/melt kernel.
+    """
+    fl = _W_R.shape[1]
+    if center:
+        fragment = np.pad(fragment, fl // 2, mode="reflect")
+    X = _dsp.extract_frames(fragment, fl, CFG["hop_len"])             # [T, frame_len]
+    S = _project(X, np.concatenate([_W_R, _W_I], axis=0), _W_R.shape[0])  # [T, n_mels]
+    C = np.log(S + _EPS) @ _D.T                                        # [T, n_mfcc]
+    return C.T                                                          # [n_mfcc, T]
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# REPRODUCIBILITY
+# =============================================================================
+def set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
+    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# AUDIO PREPROCESSING
+# =============================================================================
+def load_audio(path: Path, sr: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    audio, _ = librosa.load(str(path), sr=sr)
+    return audio
+
+
+def sliding_windows(audio: np.ndarray, window_sec: float, hop_sec: float,
+                    sr: int) -> list[np.ndarray]:
+    win_len  = int(window_sec * sr)
+    hop_len  = int(hop_sec   * sr)
+    n        = len(audio)
+    windows  = []
+
+    if n < win_len:
+        windows.append(np.pad(audio, (0, win_len - n)))
+        return windows
+
+    for start in range(0, n - win_len + 1, hop_len):
+        chunk = audio[start : start + win_len]
+        if len(chunk) < win_len:
+            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, win_len - len(chunk)))
+        windows.append(chunk)
+
+    return windows
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# DATASET
+# =============================================================================
+class SPIRADataset(Dataset):
+    """
+    Same as in train.py but calls compute_mfcct() instead of
+    librosa.feature.mfcc().  Requires build_mfcct_matrices() to have
+    been called before instantiation.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, csv_path: Path, data_root: Path, cfg: dict):
+        self.items: list[tuple[np.ndarray, int]] = []
+        self._patient_ids: list[int] = []
+
+        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
+        for patient_idx, (_, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):
+            full_path = data_root / row["file_path"]
+            label     = int(row["class"])
+
+            audio   = load_audio(full_path, cfg["sample_rate"])
+            windows = sliding_windows(
+                audio, cfg["window_sec"], cfg["hop_sec"], cfg["sample_rate"]
+            )
+            for win in windows:
+                mfcct = compute_mfcct(win, center=cfg.get("center", False))  # [n_mfcc, T]
+                # Add channel dim: [n_mfcc, T] → [1, n_mfcc, T]
+                self.items.append(
+                    (np.expand_dims(mfcct, 0).astype(np.float32), label)
+                )
+                self._patient_ids.append(patient_idx)
+
+        self._patient_ids = np.array(self._patient_ids, dtype=np.int64)
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.items)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, idx: int):
+        mfcct, label = self.items[idx]
+        return torch.from_numpy(mfcct), torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    @property
+    def labels(self) -> np.ndarray:
+        return np.array([item[1] for item in self.items], dtype=np.int64)
+
+    @property
+    def patient_ids(self) -> np.ndarray:
+        return self._patient_ids
+
+    def patient_labels(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+        unique_pids = np.unique(self._patient_ids)
+        labels_arr  = self.labels
+        pid_labels  = np.array(
+            [labels_arr[self._patient_ids == pid][0] for pid in unique_pids],
+            dtype=np.int64,
+        )
+        return unique_pids, pid_labels
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# MODEL — CasanovaCNN  (unchanged from train.py)
+# =============================================================================
+class Mish(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return x * torch.tanh(F.softplus(x))
+
+
+def _same_padding(kernel_size: int, dilation: int) -> int:
+    return (dilation * (kernel_size - 1) + 1) // 2
+
+
+class CasanovaCNN(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, input_shape: tuple[int, int, int],
+                 dropout_prob: float = 0.70):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.act = Mish()
+
+        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(input_shape[0], 32, 7,
+                               dilation=2, padding=_same_padding(7, 2))
+        self.gn1   = nn.GroupNorm(16, 32)
+        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))
+        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout2d(dropout_prob)
+
+        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 5,
+                               dilation=2, padding=_same_padding(5, 2))
+        self.gn2   = nn.GroupNorm(8, 16)
+        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))
+        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout2d(dropout_prob)
+
+        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(16, 8, 3,
+                               dilation=2, padding=_same_padding(3, 2))
+        self.gn3   = nn.GroupNorm(4, 8)
+        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))
+        self.drop3 = nn.Dropout2d(dropout_prob)
+
+        self.conv4 = nn.Conv2d(8, 4, 2,
+                               padding=_same_padding(2, 1))
+        self.gn4   = nn.GroupNorm(2, 4)
+        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1))
+        self.drop4 = nn.Dropout2d(dropout_prob)
+
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            dummy     = torch.zeros(1, *input_shape)
+            flat_feat = self._forward_conv(dummy)
+            self.flat_size = flat_feat.view(1, -1).size(1)
+
+        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(self.flat_size, 128)
+        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 64)
+        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(64, 1)
+
+    def _forward_conv(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = self.drop1(self.pool1(self.act(self.gn1(self.conv1(x)))))
+        x = self.drop2(self.pool2(self.act(self.gn2(self.conv2(x)))))
+        x = self.drop3(self.pool3(self.act(self.gn3(self.conv3(x)))))
+        x = self.drop4(self.pool4(self.act(self.gn4(self.conv4(x)))))
+        return x
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = self._forward_conv(x)
+        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
+        x = self.act(self.fc1(x))
+        x = self.act(self.fc2(x))
+        return self.fc3(x)
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# LEARNING-RATE SCHEDULER
+# =============================================================================
+def noam_lr_lambda(step: int, warmup_steps: int = 1000) -> float:
+    step = max(step, 1)
+    return warmup_steps ** 0.5 * min(step ** -0.5,
+                                      step * warmup_steps ** -1.5)
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# TRAINING HELPERS  (unchanged from train.py)
+# =============================================================================
+def train_one_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, scheduler, criterion,
+                    device, use_amp=False):
+    model.train()
+    total_loss = correct = n = 0
+    amp_dtype  = torch.bfloat16 if use_amp else None
+
+    for X, y in loader:
+        X, y = X.to(device, non_blocking=True), y.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+        optimizer.zero_grad()
+
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type,
+                            dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
+            out  = model(X).squeeze(1)
+            loss = criterion(out, y)
+
+        loss.backward()
+        optimizer.step()
+        scheduler.step()
+
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            preds    = (out.float() > 0.0).float()
+            correct += (preds == y).sum().item()
+        n          += y.size(0)
+        total_loss += loss.item() * y.size(0)
+
+    return total_loss / n, correct / n
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def evaluate(model, loader, criterion, device, use_amp=False):
+    model.eval()
+    total_loss = correct = n = 0
+    amp_dtype  = torch.bfloat16 if use_amp else None
+
+    for X, y in loader:
+        X, y = X.to(device, non_blocking=True), y.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type,
+                            dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
+            out  = model(X).squeeze(1)
+            loss = criterion(out, y)
+        preds       = (out.float() > 0.0).float()
+        correct    += (preds == y).sum().item()
+        n          += y.size(0)
+        total_loss += loss.item() * y.size(0)
+
+    return total_loss / n, correct / n
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def compute_metrics(model, loader, device, threshold=0.5, use_amp=False):
+    model.eval()
+    all_probs:  list[float] = []
+    all_labels: list[int]   = []
+    amp_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if use_amp else None
+
+    for X, y in loader:
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type,
+                            dtype=amp_dtype, enabled=use_amp):
+            logits = model(X.to(device, non_blocking=True)).squeeze(1)
+        probs = torch.sigmoid(logits).float().cpu().numpy()
+        all_probs.extend(probs.tolist())
+        all_labels.extend(y.numpy().tolist())
+
+    probs  = np.array(all_probs)
+    labels = np.array(all_labels, dtype=int)
+    preds  = (probs > threshold).astype(int)
+
+    return dict(
+        accuracy  = float(accuracy_score(labels, preds)),
+        precision = float(precision_score(labels, preds, zero_division=0)),
+        recall    = float(recall_score(labels, preds, zero_division=0)),
+        f1        = float(f1_score(labels, preds, zero_division=0)),
+        auc       = float(roc_auc_score(labels, probs)),
+        confusion_matrix = confusion_matrix(labels, preds).tolist(),
+    )
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# CROSS-VALIDATION
+# =============================================================================
+def run_cross_validation(full_dataset, cfg, device, out_dir, log):
+    unique_pids, pid_labels = full_dataset.patient_labels()
+    skf          = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=cfg["n_folds"],
+                                   shuffle=True, random_state=cfg["seed"])
+    all_pids     = full_dataset.patient_ids
+    fold_results = []
+
+    for fold, (tr_pat, vl_pat) in enumerate(
+            skf.split(np.zeros(len(unique_pids)), pid_labels), start=1):
+
+        log.info(f"\n{'─'*60}")
+        log.info(f"  FOLD {fold} / {cfg['n_folds']}")
+        log.info(f"{'─'*60}")
+
+        tr_patients = set(unique_pids[tr_pat])
+        vl_patients = set(unique_pids[vl_pat])
+        train_idx   = np.where(np.isin(all_pids, list(tr_patients)))[0]
+        val_idx     = np.where(np.isin(all_pids, list(vl_patients)))[0]
+
+        log.info(f"  Patients — train: {len(tr_patients)}  val: {len(vl_patients)}")
+        log.info(f"  Windows  — train: {len(train_idx)}  val: {len(val_idx)}")
+
+        train_sub = Subset(full_dataset, train_idx)
+        val_sub   = Subset(full_dataset, val_idx)
+        nw = cfg["num_workers"]
+        pf = cfg["prefetch_factor"] if nw > 0 else None
+        train_ld  = DataLoader(train_sub, batch_size=cfg["batch_size"],
+                               shuffle=True,  num_workers=nw,
+                               pin_memory=cfg["pin_memory"],
+                               persistent_workers=(nw > 0),
+                               prefetch_factor=pf)
+        val_ld    = DataLoader(val_sub,   batch_size=cfg["batch_size"],
+                               shuffle=False, num_workers=nw,
+                               pin_memory=cfg["pin_memory"],
+                               persistent_workers=(nw > 0),
+                               prefetch_factor=pf)
+
+        sample_shape = full_dataset[0][0].shape
+        model  = CasanovaCNN(sample_shape, cfg["dropout"]).to(device)
+        crit   = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
+        opt    = optim.Adam(model.parameters(),
+                            lr=cfg["lr"], weight_decay=cfg["weight_decay"])
+        sched  = LambdaLR(opt, lr_lambda=lambda s: noam_lr_lambda(
+                              s, cfg["warmup_steps"]))
+        use_amp = cfg["use_amp"] and device.type == "cuda"
+
+        best_val_loss = float("inf")
+        best_state    = None
+        no_improve    = 0
+
+        for epoch in range(1, cfg["epochs"] + 1):
+            tr_loss, tr_acc = train_one_epoch(
+                model, train_ld, opt, sched, crit, device, use_amp)
+            vl_loss, vl_acc = evaluate(model, val_ld, crit, device, use_amp)
+
+            improved = vl_loss < best_val_loss
+            if improved:
+                best_val_loss = vl_loss
+                best_state    = {k: v.cpu().clone()
+                                 for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+                no_improve    = 0
+                tag = " ✓"
+            else:
+                no_improve += 1
+                tag = ""
+
+            log.info(
+                f"  Fold {fold} | Ep {epoch:4d}/{cfg['epochs']} | "
+                f"tr_loss={tr_loss:.4f} tr_acc={tr_acc:.4f} | "
+                f"vl_loss={vl_loss:.4f} vl_acc={vl_acc:.4f}{tag}"
+            )
+
+            if no_improve >= cfg["patience"]:
+                log.info(f"  Early stopping at epoch {epoch} "
+                         f"(no improvement for {cfg['patience']} epochs)")
+                break
+
+        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+        metrics = compute_metrics(model, val_ld, device, use_amp=use_amp)
+        metrics["fold"] = fold
+
+        ckpt_path = out_dir / f"spira_mfcct_fold{fold}_best.pth"
+        torch.save(best_state, ckpt_path)
+        log.info(f"  Fold {fold} checkpoint → {ckpt_path.name}")
+        log.info(
+            f"  Fold {fold} BEST → "
+            f"acc={metrics['accuracy']:.4f}  "
+            f"prec={metrics['precision']:.4f}  "
+            f"rec={metrics['recall']:.4f}  "
+            f"f1={metrics['f1']:.4f}  "
+            f"auc={metrics['auc']:.4f}"
+        )
+        fold_results.append(metrics)
+
+    return fold_results
+
+
+# =============================================================================
+# FINAL MODEL
+# =============================================================================
+def train_final_model(train_dataset, cfg, device, out_dir, log):
+    log.info(f"\n{'═'*60}")
+    log.info("  FINAL MODEL — training on full training set")
+    log.info(f"{'═'*60}")
+
+    nw = cfg["num_workers"]
+    pf = cfg["prefetch_factor"] if nw > 0 else None
+    train_ld = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=cfg["batch_size"],
+                          shuffle=True, num_workers=nw,
+                          pin_memory=cfg["pin_memory"],
+                          persistent_workers=(nw > 0),
+                          prefetch_factor=pf)
+
+    sample_shape = train_dataset[0][0].shape
+    model   = CasanovaCNN(sample_shape, cfg["dropout"]).to(device)
+    crit    = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
+    opt     = optim.Adam(model.parameters(),
+                         lr=cfg["lr"], weight_decay=cfg["weight_decay"])
+    sched   = LambdaLR(opt, lr_lambda=lambda s: noam_lr_lambda(
+                           s, cfg["warmup_steps"]))
+    use_amp = cfg["use_amp"] and device.type == "cuda"
+
+    best_loss  = float("inf")
+    best_state = None
+
+    for epoch in range(1, cfg["epochs"] + 1):
+        tr_loss, tr_acc = train_one_epoch(
+            model, train_ld, opt, sched, crit, device, use_amp)
+
+        improved = tr_loss < best_loss
+        if improved:
+            best_loss  = tr_loss
+            best_state = {k: v.cpu().clone()
+                          for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+
+        log.info(
+            f"  Final | Ep {epoch:4d}/{cfg['epochs']} | "
+            f"tr_loss={tr_loss:.4f} tr_acc={tr_acc:.4f}"
+            + (" ✓" if improved else "")
+        )
+
+    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+    ckpt_path = out_dir / "spira_mfcct_final_model.pth"
+    torch.save(best_state, ckpt_path)
+    log.info(f"  Final model checkpoint → {ckpt_path.name}")
+    return model
+

+# =============================================================================
+# MAIN
+# =============================================================================
+def main(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    if args.epochs:
+        CFG["epochs"] = args.epochs
+    if args.batch_size:
+        CFG["batch_size"] = args.batch_size
+    if args.warmup_steps:
+        CFG["warmup_steps"] = args.warmup_steps
+    if args.num_workers is not None:
+        CFG["num_workers"] = args.num_workers
+    if args.no_amp:
+        CFG["use_amp"] = False
+    if args.seed is not None:
+        CFG["seed"] = args.seed
+
+    data_root = Path(args.data_dir).resolve()
+    train_csv = Path(args.train_csv).resolve()
+    test_csv  = Path(args.test_csv).resolve()
+    out_dir   = Path(args.out_dir).resolve()
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+# =============================================================================
+# tasks/spira_train.py — train SPIRA MFCC + MFCCT models
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Paper: Camargo & Finger, "MelT: GEMM-Native NDFT ...", IEEE Access, 2026.
+#
+# CUDA-only. Thin wrapper that drives the vendored training engines
+# (spira_mfcc_model.py / spira_mfcct_model.py) to produce the checkpoints that
+# tasks/spira_eval.py consumes. SPIRA is public (CC BY-SA 4.0, see data/spira.md).
+#
+# Single-seed (default): writes datasets/spira/checkpoints/
+#   spira_final_model.pth         (MFCC baseline)
+#   spira_mfcct_final_model.pth   (MFCCT)
+# Multi-seed (Tier 2): pass seeds=[...] (CLI --seeds) to train each seed into
+#   datasets/spira/checkpoints/seed_<s>/{spira_final_model.pth, spira_mfcct_final_model.pth}
+# so tasks/spira_eval.py --seeds can report mean+/-std + a Wilcoxon paired test
+# across seeds (robustness evidence). License: MIT.
+# =============================================================================
+"""Train the SPIRA MFCC and MFCCT models (single- or multi-seed) via the engines."""
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .. import _common as C
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+# (engine module, output checkpoint name) for the two front-end variants
+ENGINES = [("spira_mfcc_model", "spira_final_model.pth"),         # MFCC baseline
+           ("spira_mfcct_model", "spira_mfcct_final_model.pth")]  # MFCCT
+
+
+def _train_into(out_dir, root, train_csv, test_csv, force, seed=None):
+    """Train both engines into `out_dir`; skip an engine whose checkpoint exists."""
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for engine, ckpt_name in ENGINES:
+        target = out_dir / ckpt_name
+        if target.exists() and not force:
+            print(f"  skip (exists): {target}"); continue
+        cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / f"{engine}.py"),
+               "--data-dir", str(root), "--train-csv", str(train_csv),
+               "--test-csv", str(test_csv), "--out-dir", str(out_dir)]
+        if seed is not None:
+            cmd += ["--seed", str(seed)]
+        print("  [spira-train]", " ".join(cmd))
+        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
+
+
+def run(platform_id=None, force=False, seeds=None, **_):
+    cfg = C.load_config("spira")
+    root = Path(cfg["dataset_root"]) / "spira"
+    train_csv = root / "metadata_train.csv"
+    test_csv = root / "metadata_test.csv"
+    ckpt = root / "checkpoints"
+    assert train_csv.exists(), f"missing {train_csv} (see data/spira.md)"
+
+    if seeds:
+        for s in seeds:                       # per-seed checkpoints/seed_<s>/
+            print(f"  == SPIRA training seed {s} ==")
+            _train_into(ckpt / f"seed_{s}", root, train_csv, test_csv, force, seed=s)
+        print(f"  multi-seed checkpoints -> {ckpt}/seed_<s>/  (seeds={seeds})")
+        return
+
+    _train_into(ckpt, root, train_csv, test_csv, force)   # single (default-seed) run
+    print(f"  checkpoints -> {ckpt}")

+# =============================================================================
+# tasks/voxceleb.py — VoxCeleb1 gender, same-frontend + cross-eval -> Table VIII
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Paper: Camargo & Finger, "MelT: GEMM-Native NDFT ...", IEEE Access, 2026.
+#
+# CUDA-only; result is hardware-independent. Drives the vendored, leakage-aware
+# classifier engine (voxceleb_classify.py — verbatim from the original) for BOTH
+# front-end pairs the paper reports:
+#   * mfcc_mfcct : Standard MFCC vs MFCCT  (same-frontend + cross-eval)
+#   * mel_meltf  : STFT+Mel vs MelT        (same-frontend + cross-eval)
+# The engine writes a paired comparison CSV per pair into results/raw/tasks/;
+# this wrapper invokes it and leaves those CSVs as the Table VIII artifacts.
+#
+# Ported from exp/exp-arxiv-03-clf/classify_v2.py. Adjust the dataset flags below
+# to your VoxCeleb1 layout (see data/voxceleb.md). Output: results/raw/tasks/.
+# License: MIT.
+# =============================================================================
+"""Run the vendored VoxCeleb classifier for both front-end pairs (Table VIII)."""
+import csv as _csv
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from melt import io, stats
+from .. import _common as C
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PAIRS = ("mfcc_mfcct", "mel_meltf")
+
+
+def _run_engine(pair, manifest, corpus, out_dir, seed=None):
+    """Invoke the classifier engine for one pair into out_dir; return its CSV row dict."""
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / "voxceleb_classify.py"),
+           "--manifest", str(manifest), "--manifest-root", str(corpus),
+           "--pair", pair, "--label-col", "gender", "--group-col", "speaker",
+           "--group-disjoint", "--dataset-name", "voxceleb1", "--out-dir", str(out_dir)]
+    if seed is not None:
+        cmd += ["--seed", str(seed)]
+    print("  [voxceleb]", " ".join(cmd))
+    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
+    f = out_dir / f"voxceleb1_{pair}_fair.csv"
+    with open(f, newline="") as fh:
+        rows = list(_csv.DictReader(fh))
+    return rows[0] if rows else {}
+
+
+def run(platform_id=None, force=False, seeds=None, **_):
+    cfg = C.load_config("voxceleb")
+    # Absolute paths: the engine runs with cwd=out (so its results land there),
+    # so manifest/corpus passed to it must NOT be relative to that cwd.
+    # Absolute paths: the engine receives an explicit --out-dir, so it writes the
+    # per-pair files DIRECTLY into results/raw/tasks/ (no nested results/ folder).
+    out = io.out_dir(tasks=True).resolve()
+    corpus = (Path(cfg["dataset_root"]) / "voxceleb1").resolve()
+    manifest = corpus / "manifest.csv"   # MANIFEST mode: columns path,gender,speaker
+
+    if seeds:
+        _run_multiseed(seeds, force, manifest, corpus, out, platform_id)
+        return
+
+    done = out / "voxceleb.csv"
+    if done.exists() and not force:
+        print(f"  skip (exists): {done}"); return
+
+    # Run the engine per pair, writing <pair>_fair.{csv,txt} straight into `out`.
+    # If a pair's CSV already exists, REUSE it (don't recompute) — so consolidation
+    # can run from existing artifacts without re-training the classifiers.
+    for pair in ("mfcc_mfcct", "mel_meltf"):
+        pair_csv = out / f"voxceleb1_{pair}_fair.csv"
+        if pair_csv.exists() and not force:
+            print(f"  reuse existing (no rerun): {pair_csv}"); continue
+        assert manifest.exists(), (
+            f"missing {manifest}: VoxCeleb needs a manifest with columns "
+            f"path,gender,speaker (see data/voxceleb.md)")
+        cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / "voxceleb_classify.py"),
+               "--manifest", str(manifest), "--manifest-root", str(corpus),
+               "--pair", pair, "--label-col", "gender", "--group-col", "speaker",
+               "--group-disjoint", "--dataset-name", "voxceleb1",
+               "--out-dir", str(out)]
+        print("  [voxceleb]", " ".join(cmd))
+        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
+
+    # Consolidate the per-pair *_fair.csv (now directly under `out`) into one
+    # long-form Table VIII artifact. csv.reader (NOT line.split) so engine fields
+    # containing literal commas stay in one cell; one row per (source, col, value).
+    produced = sorted(out.glob("*_fair.csv"))
+    rows = []
+    for f in produced:
+        with open(f, newline="") as fh:
+            reader = _csv.reader(fh)
+            header = next(reader, [])
+            for rec in reader:
+                for col, val in zip(header, rec):
+                    rows.append([f.stem, col, val])
+    if rows:
+        io.write_csv(done, ["source", "metric", "value"], rows)
+    io.write_run_json(out, "voxceleb", platform_id, "configs/experiments/voxceleb.yaml")
+    print(f"  wrote {done}  (from {len(produced)} per-pair *_fair.csv in {out})")
+
+
+def _run_multiseed(seeds, force, manifest, corpus, out, platform_id):
+    """Run both pairs across seeds -> per-seed accuracies + mean+/-std + Wilcoxon."""
+    seeds_csv = out / "voxceleb_seeds.csv"
+    if seeds_csv.exists() and not force:
+        print(f"  skip (exists): {seeds_csv}"); return
+    assert manifest.exists(), (
+        f"missing {manifest}: VoxCeleb needs columns path,gender,speaker (data/voxceleb.md)")
+    per = []   # one record per (seed, pair)
+    for s in seeds:
+        sdir = out / "voxceleb_seeds" / f"seed_{s}"; sdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for pair in PAIRS:
+            d = _run_engine(pair, manifest, corpus, sdir, seed=s)
+            per.append({"seed": s, "pair": pair,
+                        "left_frontend": d.get("left_frontend", ""),
+                        "right_frontend": d.get("right_frontend", ""),
+                        "left_acc": d.get("left_acc", ""), "right_acc": d.get("right_acc", ""),
+                        "cross_acc": d.get("cross_acc", "")})
+    cols = ["seed", "pair", "left_frontend", "right_frontend", "left_acc", "right_acc", "cross_acc"]
+    io.write_csv(seeds_csv, cols, [[r[c] for c in cols] for r in per])
+    _summarize_seeds(per, out, platform_id)
+    print(f"  wrote {seeds_csv} + voxceleb_seeds_summary.csv  ({len(seeds)} seeds)")
+
+
+# Non-inferiority margin for the VoxCeleb gender accuracy (1 percentage point):
+# the largest accuracy drop treated as negligible for a drop-in front end.
+NONINF_MARGIN = 0.01
+
+
+def _summarize_seeds(per, out, platform_id, margin=NONINF_MARGIN):
+    """Per-pair multi-seed summary: mean+/-std of each accuracy, a Wilcoxon test on
+    the (proposed - baseline) deltas, AND a one-sided non-inferiority test of the
+    proposed front end vs the baseline at `margin` (the claim is 'not worse', not
+    'better' -- VoxCeleb gender is near-ceiling and the per-split variance dwarfs
+    the front-end effect). Writes voxceleb_seeds_summary.csv."""
+    summ = []
+    for pair in PAIRS:
+        recs = [r for r in per if r["pair"] == pair]
+        def arr(k):
+            return np.array([float(r[k]) for r in recs if r[k] not in ("", None)], float)
+        la, ra, ca = arr("left_acc"), arr("right_acc"), arr("cross_acc")
+        if la.size == 0 or ra.size != la.size:
+            continue
+        d = ra - la
+        w = stats.wilcoxon_signed_rank(d)
+        ni = stats.noninferiority(d, bound=-margin, side="lower")  # H1: mean(d) > -margin
+        cross_mean = f"{ca.mean():.4f}" if ca.size else ""
+        cross_std = f"{ca.std(ddof=1):.4f}" if ca.size > 1 else ""
+        summ.append([pair, f"{la.mean():.4f}", f"{la.std(ddof=1):.4f}",
+                     f"{ra.mean():.4f}", f"{ra.std(ddof=1):.4f}",
+                     f"{d.mean():+.4f}", f"{w['p']:.4g}",
+                     f"{margin:.2f}", f"{ni['p']:.4g}", int(bool(ni["passed"])),
+                     cross_mean, cross_std, len(d)])
+    io.write_csv(out / "voxceleb_seeds_summary.csv",
+                 ["pair", "left_mean", "left_std", "right_mean", "right_std",
+                  "delta_mean", "wilcoxon_p", "noninf_margin", "noninf_p", "noninf_pass",
+                  "cross_mean", "cross_std", "n_seeds"], summ)
+    io.write_run_json(out, "voxceleb_seeds", platform_id, "configs/experiments/voxceleb.yaml")
+
+
+def reaggregate_seeds(out, platform_id=None, margin=NONINF_MARGIN):
+    """Rebuild voxceleb_seeds_summary.csv from an existing voxceleb_seeds.csv
+    (per-seed accuracies are deterministic given the seed, so the summary can be
+    regenerated -- e.g. after changing the statistical method -- without retraining)."""
+    out = Path(out)
+    with open(out / "voxceleb_seeds.csv", newline="") as fh:
+        per = list(_csv.DictReader(fh))
+    _summarize_seeds(per, out, platform_id, margin=margin)
+    print(f"  re-aggregated voxceleb_seeds_summary.csv from {out / 'voxceleb_seeds.csv'}")
